title: Skins page: server-side pagination, search, and performance optimization
body:
## Summary

Optimizes the Skins page for 476K+ records by adding server-side pagination and search.

**API changes (`GET /api/skins`):**
- Added `page` (default 1) and `pageSize` (10–500, default 100) query params
- Added `search` param — filters by farmer, farm, barcode, or box number
- Response now includes `filteredCount`, `page`, `pageSize`, `totalPages` metadata
- Only fetches the requested page from SQL (OFFSET/FETCH), not all rows
- Counts (total/sold/unsold) done at DB level with `COUNT()`

**UI changes:**
- Pagination controls (First/Prev/1-5/Next/Last) with page numbers
- Search box with Enter-to-search and Clear button
- Page size selector (50/100/200/500 per page)
- Shows "Showing X–Y of Z" indicator
